<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Back to original state. Player at (37, 20), 14 greens, 3 purples.
# New strategy: move RIGHT to col 50, then click safe green blocks (not in player's column).
# In original state, player at col 20, so avoid cols 19-23.
# In rearranged state, player at col 39, so avoid cols 37-41.

# First, move RIGHT to col 50
# Player is at col 20, need to move 30 steps right
result = action(['RIGHT'] * 30)
print(f"Moved RIGHT 30 steps")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
player = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b']
pp = None
if player:
    b = player[0]['boundary']
    pp = (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
print(f"Player now at: {pp}")

# Now identify safe green blocks (not in cols 19-23 since player is at col ~50)
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"\nGreen blocks: {len(greens)}")
safe_clicks = []
for n in greens:
    b = n['boundary']
    minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
    maxc = max(p[1] for p in b)
    minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
    maxr = max(p[0] for p in b)
    center_r = (minr + maxr) // 2
    center_c = (minc + maxc) // 2
    # Player is at col 50, so all green blocks are far from player - all should be safe
    safe_clicks.append((center_r, center_c))
    print(f"  ({minr},{minc})-({maxr},{maxc}) -> click ({center_r},{center_c})")

# Click all 14 green blocks
actions = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in safe_clicks]
result = action(actions)
print(f"\nClicked {len(actions)} green blocks")
print(f"game_over={result.get('game_over')}, gameplay_changed={result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = len([n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N'])
purs = len([n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p' and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) < 60])
player = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b']
pp = None
if player:
    b = player[0]['boundary']
    pp = (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
print(f"After: greens={greens}, purples={purs}, player={pp}")

if result.get('level_completed'):
    print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
if result.get('done'):
    print("GAME DONE!")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
